snippet.title: Jolly Match 3 MR - Official Trailer | Upload VR Showcase Winter 2025
snippet.description: Get a deep dive into Jolly Match 3 MR in this trailer for the free-to-play match-3 puzzle game for mixed reality. In Jolly Match 3 MR, interact with dazzling puzzles in your own space. Swap, match, hit awesome combos, and rediscover the fun of classic puzzle game in a totally new way. The new Jolly Match 3 MR trailer showcases locations and the new Seasonal Winter update, with a winter event happening from today (December 5, 2025) to January 18, 2026. Jolly Match 3 MR is available on Meta Quest.
